inventory_provenance.why_the_pool_is_264: AMBIGUITY F2, flagged not invented: doc 63 SS8.2 V5 requires every non-bearer in >= 1 TRAIN cast, and SS6.1 freezes the budget at 960 items = 264 train pairs. At n = 2 a train pair hosts one non-bearer, so 264 is the arithmetic ceiling. The pool is held FIXED ACROSS EVERY CELL so the noun population does not move along the n axis.
